import random

def rotl8(v,n):
    return ((v<<n)|(v>>(8-n)))&0xff

def g(a,b,x):
    return rotl8((a+b+x)&0xff,2)

def f(x):
    xs=[(x>>(8*i))&0xff for i in range(4)]
    y=[0]*4
    y[2]=g(xs[3]^xs[2], xs[1]^xs[0], 1)
    y[3]=g(xs[3], y[2], 0)
    y[1]=g(xs[1]^xs[0], y[2], 0)
    y[0]=g(xs[0], y[1], 1)
    return sum(y[i]<<(8*i) for i in range(4))

def dot(mask,x):
    return bin((mask&x)).count('1')&1
